body.x: [Pipeline Position] Program Implementation and Performance Manager (Africa Regional Office) [Based in Kigali]
***This is a pipeline position created to prepare for anticipated hiring needs. Final hiring decisions will be made following internal review processes.***

We are seeking a Program Implementation and Performance Manager for 2-year-regular position (renewable) to work within Africa Regional Office at the International Vaccine Institute in Kigali, Rwanda. (Duty station: Kigali, Rwanda)

This role is responsible for the technical implementation of VEA4A, working with the Program Director, participating institutions and other partners to translate programme objectives into activities and apply technical expertise throughout implementation. Its responsibilities also include institutional readiness, programme performance, monitoring, evaluation and learning, inclusion, safeguarding coordination and implementation learning for VEA4A. It also encompasses the day-to-day management and coordination of programme implementation, including planning, resource and budget monitoring, risk management and reporting, to support the delivery of agreed commitments on time, within budget and to the required quality standards. The role works with the Program Director, participating institutions and other partners to monitor progress and inform programme adaptations.
1. Institutional readiness assessment and programme performance monitoring
Lead HEI readiness assessment, institutional-strengthening monitoring and readiness recommendations with the Training Lead and HEI teams.
Lead the MEL framework, indicator definitions, data-quality arrangements, performance dashboards, quarterly reviews, learning briefs and programme reporting.
Integrate evidence from training, HEIs, participants and employment pathways and recommend adaptations to the Program Director.
Facilitate narrative and performance reporting to the Foundation and ensure timely technical, budget and partner inputs.
Manage day-to-day implementation in accordance with IVI Project Management Guidelines, monitoring progress against the approved workplan, timeline, quality requirements and budget.
Translate the approved proposal, workplan and budget into integrated annual, quarterly and detailed implementation plans.
Own the master workplan, critical path, milestones, dependencies, resource plan and consolidated delivery calendar.
Coordinate routine implementation across ARUA, HEIs, IVI technical teams, functional units, providers and all programme workstreams.
Manage scope, schedule, deliverables, risks, issues, decisions, changes, assumptions and corrective actions through documented project controls.
Monitor partner deliverables and programme commitments and ensure that delays or performance concerns receive timely action.
Chair routine implementation meetings and act for the Program Director on operational matters when formally delegated.
3. Budget tracking and programme document preparation

Monitor programme expenditure and support budget phasing and forecasting, working with the Project Administrator and relevant colleagues to identify and communicate variances against the approved budget.
Contribute to the preparation of programme-related agreements and contracts with participating institutions, service providers and other partners, in coordination with relevant IVI functions.
4. Systems oversight and safeguarding & inclusion facilitation
Lead data-quality arrangements for programme monitoring and reporting.
Oversee programme-wide digital operations, including the relationship among applications, LMS, participant records, course records and reporting systems.
Facilitate the implementation of safeguarding, inclusion and data-protection requirements across the programme, working with IVI specialist functions and partners.
Advanced degree in health sciences, public health, project management, development, education, social sciences or a related field.
Substantial experience managing complex, multi-partner and donor-funded programmes, preferably across more than one country.
Demonstrated knowledge of project planning, scope and change control, risk management, partner performance, budget monitoring and donor reporting.
Experience in monitoring, evaluation and learning (MEL), data quality and institutional-capacity assessment.
Understanding of safeguarding and inclusive programme delivery.
Experience in workforce development, higher education, health training or vaccine-related programmes is desirable.
Programme performance monitoring and use of evidence.
Ability to move between strategic context and operational detail.
Project Management Professional (PMP) certification is desirable.
***IVI welcomes applications from all sections of the community. We encourage women to apply, especially from countries that are currently under-represented within IVI.***
